slides.title: Choosing Wisely in Pediatric Asthma: Reducing Unnecessary Chest Radiographs
slides.subtitle: A quality improvement project at NYC Health + Hospitals / Lincoln Medical Center, South Bronx
narration: This is a quality improvement project about chest radiographs in children with asthma.
It took place at NYC Health and Hospitals, Lincoln Medical Center, in the South Bronx.

slides.title: What an acute exacerbation is treated with, and what it is not

stats.label: not routinely advised during an exacerbation
exacerbations are imaged all the same

narration: Only two to five percent have pneumonia on the film.
Yet about one in three is imaged.

slides.title: Three words that decide the visit

stats.label: given early, within the first hour
only with a specific clinical risk factor
of baseline radiographs did not meet the guideline

narration: At baseline, seventy-nine and a half percent did not meet the guideline.

slides.title: The change in imaging, and the gap it measures

stats.label: radiographs per 1000 asthma visits, before and after
imaged visits, white versus Black children, in 44 children's hospitals

narration: Radiographs fell from eleven point two to four point six per thousand visits.
And the published gap: thirty-three and a half percent against twenty-four point one.

cells: Adjusted odds 0.60 for non-Hispanic Black children
A high-burden population and a local baseline
White children receive more low-value imaging
Readiness lowers imaging, not the disparity

slides.title: The project, month by month

events.label: Baseline
events.text: Chart review of radiographs from July to December 2025

events.label: Education
events.text: Teaching on guideline indications for every clinician

events.label: Order set
events.text: Radiograph ordering requires a documented risk factor

events.label: Reassessment
events.text: Bronchohyperresponsiveness reassessed after bronchodilators, before any imaging

events.label: Feedback
events.text: Monthly feedback on each clinician's radiograph rate

events.label: Post-intervention
events.text: Re-audit with the equity measure reported honestly

narration: The project ran in six steps.

slides.title: Before a radiograph is ordered

steps.label: Bronchodilators
steps.text: Give inhaled bronchodilators and systemic corticosteroids

steps.label: Reassessment
steps.text: Reassess the work of breathing and the oxygen saturation

steps.label: Risk factors
steps.text: Focal findings, persistent hypoxemia, fever or suspected pneumothorax

steps.label: Radiograph-indication
steps.text: Order a radiograph only for a documented indication

narration: Image only for a documented indication.

slides.title: Each month of the project

steps.label: Order-set redesign
steps.text: A risk factor is documented first

steps.label: Monthly feedback
steps.text: Each clinician sees their own rate

steps.label: Re-audit
steps.text: The equity measure is reported honestly

narration: Each month ran as a cycle.
